build_write_denied_paths: build a set of sensitive file paths that must never be written to
build_write_denied_prefixes: build a list of sensitive directory prefixes that must never be written to
is_write_denied: test if a given file path is blocked by the write denylist or safe root
get_safe_write_root: get the resolved HERMES_WRITE_SAFE_ROOT environment variable path
get_read_block_error: check if a file path targets internal Hermes cache directories and return an error message
